cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Consequences Compound
cards.instruction: Make each new choice carry a larger reward, cost, audience, or point of no return.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose between our two biscuit plates. The winner goes to the neighbourhood meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry whichever you choose. It's our new committee's first offering to the neighbours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put both our names beside your choice. I'll write the label for the whole street to see.
